title: Out-of-band testing, OAST (Akshath Kothari, 2021 GSoC)
description: The OAST add-on from its first commit in June 2021 through BOAST, Interactsh and its use by scan rules, with the matching change in ZAP core.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry and the launch post
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Akshath Kothari for "Out-of-band Application Security Testing", GSoC, 2021 Summer, with blog and add-on links. The blog post, dated 2021-08-23, says the OAST add-on lets ZAP communicate with out-of-band testing services, "currently supports two services: BOAST and Callbacks", and notes that Callbacks was previously part of ZAP core. The URL of that post contains "owasp-zap"; that is only its address.

chapters.title: June to August 2021: first commit to first releases
chapters.text: The earliest commit under addOns/oast is "oast: Initial commit" by ricekot, dated 2021-06-18; "oast: First Version" is dated 2021-07-14 (git date order is not strictly the order of the log). The changelog lists 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 on 2021-08-04 and 0.2.0 on 2021-08-17, which adds polling frequency for BOAST servers, a table of payloads and canary values, and two example scripts. "oast: Release add-on" is dated 2021-08-19.

chapters.title: After the blog post: Interactsh and a core deprecation
chapters.text: "oast: Add \"Poll Now\" button" is dated 2021-08-25 and "oast: Support interactsh" 2021-08-29, merged on 2021-09-22. In zaproxy, "Deprecate extension callback" by Akshath Kothari is dated 2021-09-23. In zap-extensions, "oast, ascanrulesBeta: Remove usages of CallbackImplementor" is dated 2021-12-06. In the dataset, addon:ascanrules and addon:ascanrulesBeta both list addon:oast as a dependency.

chapters.title: 2022 onward: other contributors and maintenance
chapters.text: Later commits include "oast: use server provided by the Network add-on" (2022-01-31), "oast: Add statistics" (2022-02-18), "chore: OAST: Help document default services" (2022-05-18), "oast: stop polling on shutdown" (2025-10-07) and "oast: generate Interactsh identifiers using native alphabets" (2026-10-10). The changelog lists 0.26.0 on 2026-09-16 and the dataset gives the add-on beta status, so it still exists at HEAD.
